Un carrefour pour l'innovation technolog: A hub for technological innovation and entrepreneurship in Béjaïa
Initié par l'entreprise Multi Projects I: Initiated by the company Multi Projects Investissements (MPI) under the auspices of the Ministry of Knowledge Economy, Start-ups and Micro-enterprises, this forum aims to create synergies between idea holders, start-ups, industrialists and various players in the tech ecosystem. Discussions mainly focused on the challenges of digital and industrial transition, the emergence of new economic models and partnership opportunities.
L'événement a réuni le ministre de l'Éco: The event brought together the Minister of Knowledge Economy, Start-ups and Micro-enterprises, Noureddine Ouaddah, the Director of Institutional Affairs, Media Relations and CSR at Ooredoo Algeria, Ramdane Djezairi, as well as local economic operators. The forum was also marked by the inauguration of the city of Akbou's first local data center, named "OneCloud".
Un engagement continu en faveur des jeun: A continuous commitment to young project holders
Ce partenariat s'inscrit dans la continu: This partnership is part of Ooredoo's ongoing actions in favor of entrepreneurship. In 2025, the operator supported the fourth edition of the national caravan, notably during the "72 hours for entrepreneurship in Algeria" event. During the same year, Ooredoo's t-Start incubator hosted an intensive training program for twenty young project holders.
Ooredoo Algérie a parrainé le Forum écon: Ooredoo Algeria sponsored the Economic Forum on Open Innovation and Industry 4.0 in Akbou, in the wilaya of Béjaïa.
L'événement a été organisé le jeudi 1er: The event was organized on Thursday, October 1, 2026, by the company Multi Projects Investissements (MPI) under the patronage of the Ministry of Knowledge Economy, Start-ups and Micro-enterprises.
Le ministre de tutelle, Noureddine Ouadd: The supervising minister, Noureddine Ouaddah, and the Ooredoo representative, Ramdane Djezairi, took part in the proceedings alongside economic players.
Le premier centre de données local d'Akb: Akbou's first local data center, named "OneCloud", was officially inaugurated during this gathering.
En 2025, Ooredoo avait déjà soutenu la 4: In 2025, Ooredoo had already supported the 4th edition of this caravan by hosting ten projects (twenty participants) for a bootcamp within its t-Start incubator.
Quatre projets innovants lauréats de l'é: Four innovative winning projects from the 2025 edition were integrated into the t-Start incubator to benefit from technological and commercial support.
